customsClearanceMode.description:
Customs clearance mode for this manifest:
- `STANDARD`: Regular postal/commercial clearance
- `EXPRESS`: Expedited/courier clearance
- `OVERSEAS_CCC_DIRECT`: Direct cross-border e-commerce clearance

toPortCode.description: Destination port/airport code - Use 3-letter IATA code for AIR transport (example LIM, SCL)

eta.description: Estimated time of arrival (example 2024-01-20T14:30:00Z) - Must be on or after MAWB creation
